title: Control the driven island with the actual correlated bath
statement: The acquired local proof integrates the return kernel to C_R<=8[(H+1)ln2+1]/kappa. For actual unconditional drive confined INSIDE the healthy-exterior rectangle, ||V||diamond<=2v with v<=ab*h. An exact Duhamel identity keeps the later driven factors CPTP and yields full joint diamond distance to vacuum times the ACTUAL driven bath marginal <=min(2,2v*C_R), uniformly in time and bath/reference dimension/state. Noncommuting time-dependent bath operators are allowed; no measurement, reset, shape-conditioned drive or positive rare-fault mixture is introduced. For a2x2island at h/kappa=1/1024, the rational ln2<.7 bound gives <=19/80. The global allowed fault class is not replaced by confined drive: overlap, boundary health and rarity on the driven torus remain unproved. Shared bath does not imply a spatial Lieb-Robinson model. The final arbitrary-initial-island channel extension is min(2,epsilon_R(t)+2v*C_R). Its actual bath marginal may retain the initial island information;return of syndrome excitation does not erase the persistent bath.
